title: Private Guided Tour of Halifax with Visit to Peggy’s Cove
includes: Complimentary hotel pick up and drop off in Downtown Halifax.
Beautiful scenic drive up to Peggy’s Cove and free time to explore the area
Private Tour Guide for exclusive fully narrated tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Best of Halifax on this exclusive & private 4-hour small-group tour where you will discover the beauty and history of the coastal city of Halifax and nearby Peggy’s Cove on this small-group tour. You’ll have a chance to visit the famous Peggy’s Cove Lighthouse and picturesque Peggy’s Cove fishing village before heading back to Halifax to explore Citadel Hill and enjoy a narrated driving tour of the city.
